path.title: Doc path
path.description: Show this doc (e.g. concepts/layouts) instead of the one in the URL. Empty = the page route (the docs portal's '*' page; '' is index).

tocDepth.title: Table of contents depth
tocDepth.description: Deepest heading level listed in "On this page".

prevNext.title: Previous / next links
prevNext.description: Cards to the neighbouring pages in nav order.

editUrl.title: Edit link URL
editUrl.description: Template for an "Edit on GitHub" button; {source} = repository path (docs/guide/…md), {path} = doc path. Empty hides it.
